headlines.text: On this day in 2025, Kenny Omega vs. Brody King vs. Claudio Castagnoli vs. Mascara Dorada went to battle over the AEW International Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 8.45 ? a genuinely great match. Mascara Dorada was challenging for gold for the very first time. In a hard-hitting four-way also involving Brody King and Mascara Dorada, Omega retained the AEW International Championship over Claudio Castagnoli.
